title: Alpaca partial-TP remainder with its stop already crossed: no exit path. After #25790 cancels a partially filled target, the venue holds fewer shares than the row journals, so _alpaca_rearm_preflight takes its deficit branch BEFORE _breach_state. If the row stop is through the market by then, that branch returns all_stops_breached (page only): neither the partial-TP pending retry nor the exit_breached trade-scoped close runs, so the remainder sits unprotected with a page every tick and no exit. Fix (Tier 2): for a row in _ALPACA_PARTIAL_TP_PENDING (or a single attributable row) whose stop is marketable, hand over to the exit_breached flow (confirmed fresh trade -> _exit_alpaca_row reason=sl; unconfirmed -> the bounded deferral). Due before the first real-money partial TP.
